complete.rationale: Every criterion is stated with verifiable evidence.

gaps.rationale: Readable and partly actionable, but unmeasurable and unbounded.

gaming.rationale: Fluent template filler fails quantified metrics, failure acceptance criteria, assumptions, operational ownership, and governance requirements.

notes.rationale: Enthusiastic prose with no decidable content.

placeholders.rationale: Complete-looking template whose every value is a placeholder.
